name: DST gap: a start inside the spring-forward gap moves forward by the gap
note: America/New_York skips 02:00 to 02:59 on 2026-03-08, so 02:30 local does not exist. RFC 5545 and the JDK resolve a nonexistent local time by moving forward by the gap: 02:30 becomes 03:30 EDT (UTC-4), which is 07:30Z. The next day, 2026-03-09, is an ordinary EDT day, so 02:30 local is 06:30Z. A library that instead moves backward or drops the occurrence disagrees with this vector.
